gloss: to spin round and round; to go round in circles

definitions.gloss: to spin round and round; to rotate continuously; to go round in circles
definitions.explanation: To turn repeatedly in a circular motion, whether literally (a wheel, a top, a carousel) or figuratively (one's thoughts, a conversation that gets nowhere). The mimetic adverb ぐるぐる suggests multiple continuous rotations rather than a single turn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観覧車|かんらんしゃ}→観覧車：09221_kanransha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧ぐるぐる{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The Ferris wheel is slowly spinning round and round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぐるぐる{回|まわ}って、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: The same thought kept going round and round in my head, and I couldn't fall asleep.

notes:
Combines the mimetic adverb ⟦ぐるぐる→ぐるぐる：05160_guruguru⟧ ('round and round, spinning repeatedly') with the intransitive godan verb ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ ('to turn, rotate'). Refers to sustained circular motion — not a single rotation but many. Used both literally for rotating objects and figuratively for restless thoughts or unproductive discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐるぐる{回|まわ}る: one's head/eyes spin (dizzy, overwhelmed)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぐるぐる{回|まわ}る: (a thought) goes round and round in one's mind
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぐるぐる{回|まわ}る: to keep going in circles (same place)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐるぐる{回|まわ}る: the conversation goes in circles
- ⟦{洗濯|せんたく}{機|き}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐるぐる{回|まわ}る: the washing machine spins

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to turn, rotate — the base verb; a single turn or unmarked rotation
- ⟦くるくる→くるくる：05352_kurukuru⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to spin lightly/gracefully — faster, lighter, and smaller than ⟦ぐるぐる→ぐるぐる：05160_guruguru⟧
- ぐるっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to turn once all the way around — a single complete rotation
- ⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rotate — more formal/technical, used for machines and physics
- ⟦ぐるぐる→ぐるぐる：05160_guruguru⟧: repeated, heavy or continuous rotation (often big or anxious)
- ⟦くるくる→くるくる：05352_kurukuru⟧: lighter, quicker, smaller circles (often playful or pleasant)
- ぐるっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: one complete turn, then stop

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ is intransitive. The transitive counterpart is ⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ — so 'to spin something round and round' is ⟦ぐるぐる→ぐるぐる：05160_guruguru⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧.
